name: citymeter-commercialdistrict
description: CityMETER · Commercial District — 3D map of the central neighbourhood registry's outlines against 38 CityMETER datasets (Land · Location · Living; since 0.8.0 the registry's research datasets counted without their points, parks and places of worship): highlights against named peers, what comes together, similar mixes, side-by-side comparison, what lies inside and within 400 m and 800 m, who lives, visits and works around, and where and when they can spend
